subject.title: feat(ui): camera-off glyph and remembered camera state for talk calls

question: Should Talk retain and automatically apply a device-local camera preference after a session reaches listening, rather than requiring users to opt in on every call?
rationale: This adds a persistent camera-access behavior to the established Talk flow; resolving the timing defect is mechanical, but retaining the new product behavior needs explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept delayed remembered camera
options.body: Keep the preference, trigger it only after Talk is listening, and require real-browser proof for successful and failed permission paths.

options.title: Keep camera per-call only
options.body: Land the clearer camera-off glyph but remove persistence and automatic camera activation so every call remains an explicit user action.

recommendation.title: Accept delayed remembered camera
recommendation.body: Keep the preference, trigger it only after Talk is listening, and require real-browser proof for successful and failed permission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the related merged Talk camera workflow and authored this follow-up behavior.
